from __future__ import annotations

import os
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
else:
    VllmConfig = None


def use_v2_model_runner(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> bool:
    """Select the Ascend model runner.

    Model Runner V1 has been removed, so Model Runner V2 is the only
    implementation and this always returns ``True``.
    """
    return True


def _v1_runner_requested() -> bool:
    """Whether the environment explicitly selects Model Runner V1."""
    from vllm import envs

    value = getattr(envs, "VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER", None)
    if value is not None:
        return value is False
    # Upstream drops the entry together with Model Runner V1. Read the raw
    # variable so a stale ``=0`` still fails instead of being ignored.
    raw = os.getenv("VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER")
    if raw is None:
        return False
    try:
        return int(raw) == 0
    except ValueError:
        return False


def _validate_v2_model_runner(self) -> None:
    """Reject the configurations Model Runner V2 cannot serve.

    The feature list comes from upstream so it keeps growing with it. Only the
    Triton precondition is dropped: an Ascend deployment always ships Triton,
    while the CPU test lanes and config-only hosts import neither, and there
    is no V1 runner left to fall back to.
    """
    unsupported = self._get_v2_model_runner_unsupported_features()
    if unsupported:
        raise ValueError(f"Model Runner V2 does not yet support: {', '.join(unsupported)}")


def apply_v2_model_runner_config_patch() -> None:
    """Install Ascend runner selection on ``VllmConfig``.

    Re-apply in every process that reads ``use_v2_model_runner`` (frontend,
    workers, engine-core). Pickled configs do not carry this class patch.

    An explicit ``VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0`` raises: there is no V1 runner to
    select any more, and ignoring the setting would hide a stale deployment
    script.
    """
    if _v1_runner_requested():
        raise ValueError(
            "Model Runner V1 has been removed from vllm-ascend, so VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 "
            "cannot be honored. Unset it to run Model Runner V2."
        )
    from vllm.config.vllm import VllmConfig

    VllmConfig.use_v2_model_runner = property(use_v2_model_runner)
    # The guard keeps this working once upstream renames the hook.
    if hasattr(VllmConfig, "_validate_v2_model_runner"):
        VllmConfig._validate_v2_model_runner = _validate_v2_model_runner

+def _round_block_size_for_turboquant_decode(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    """Round a non-power-of-two block size up for the TurboQuant fused decode.
+
+    This is the LATE, authoritative pass of the rounding
+    ``patch_mamba_config.py`` applies early. The early pass runs at
+    model-config verification, before weights load, when
+    ``cache_config.block_size`` is still the user's value. The value that kills
+    the engine is written later: upstream ``Platform._align_hybrid_block_size``
+    (vllm/platforms/interface.py) raises the block size so the attention page
+    covers the mamba state page -- 896 = 7x128 on a Qwen3.5-class GDN hybrid,
+    which has no sparse indexer and so never passed through the early pass's
+    kpool branch either. Upstream calls that from
+    ``update_block_size_for_backend`` in the EngineCore right after
+    ``load_model`` (vllm/v1/executor/uniproc_executor.py,
+    multiproc_executor.py), and the engine then reports the value in its ready
+    response: ``vllm/v1/engine/core_client.py`` syncs
+    ``cache_config.block_size`` back to the frontend. Running the rounding at
+    the end of this same override therefore intercepts exactly the post-load
+    write, at the engine level, with engine and server unable to disagree --
+    unlike a rewrite at the API-server layer.
+
+    Rounding UP keeps the mamba-page coverage (the page only grows, and
+    ``mamba_page_size_padded`` is re-derived below), keeps the kpool indexer
+    alignment whenever that alignment is itself a power of two, and only
+    coarsens scheduling granularity. An odd factor in the kpool alignment
+    (``index_kpool`` not a power of two) makes the two constraints
+    unsatisfiable together; refuse rather than crash mid-serving in
+    ``npu_turboquant_build_decode_tiling``. MLA models are exempt: TurboQuant
+    only re-describes full-attention layers, and an MLA model has none.
+    Non-TurboQuant runs return immediately.
+    """
+    if not turboquant_enabled(vllm_config):
+        return
+    model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+    if model_config is None or getattr(model_config, "use_mla", False):
+        return
+    cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+    block_size = cache_config.block_size
+    if block_size is None or (block_size >= 64 and not block_size & (block_size - 1)):
+        return
+    decode_block_size = max(64, 1 << (block_size - 1).bit_length())
+    index_kpool = get_sparse_index_kpool(model_config)
+    if index_kpool is not None:
+        alignment_tokens = math.lcm(128, index_kpool * 16)
+        if decode_block_size % alignment_tokens:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"ENABLE_TURBOQUANT=1 needs the attention block size to be a power-of-two "
+                f"multiple of 64 for the fused decode's closed-form tile cursor, but the "
+                f"sparse index-kpool geometry (index_kpool={index_kpool}) requires a multiple "
+                f"of {alignment_tokens}, and no block size satisfies both. Run without "
+                f"ENABLE_TURBOQUANT, or without the kpool indexer."
+            )
+    logger.info(
+        "TurboQuant: rounding attention block size from %d to %d (a power-of-two multiple of 64) "
+        "for the fused decode's tile cursor, after the hybrid mamba-page alignment.",
+        block_size,
+        decode_block_size,
+    )
+    cache_config.block_size = decode_block_size
+    if cache_config.mamba_cache_mode == "align":
+        # Upstream aligned Mamba checkpoints to the pre-rounded block size.
+        # Update both token geometries before cache specs and tables are built.
+        cache_config.mamba_block_size = decode_block_size
+    # The mamba page must stay covered: the attention page just grew, so
+    # re-derive the padded mamba page from the new block size. The existing
+    # padded value is max(old attention page, mamba raw), so max() with it is
+    # max() with the mamba raw page too.
+    from vllm.utils.torch_utils import STR_DTYPE_TO_TORCH_DTYPE, get_dtype_size
+
+    kv_cache_dtype = (
+        model_config.dtype if cache_config.cache_dtype == "auto" else STR_DTYPE_TO_TORCH_DTYPE[cache_config.cache_dtype]
+    )
+    attn_page_size = (
+        2
+        * model_config.get_head_size()
+        * model_config.get_num_kv_heads(vllm_config.parallel_config)
+        * get_dtype_size(kv_cache_dtype)
+        * decode_block_size
+    )
+    if cache_config.mamba_page_size_padded is None or attn_page_size > cache_config.mamba_page_size_padded:
+        cache_config.mamba_page_size_padded = attn_page_size
+

+def _validate_turboquant_config(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    """Constraints of the ``ENABLE_TURBOQUANT`` three-plane GQA KV cache.
+
+    This is the packed 4-bit bring-up path selected by ``ENABLE_TURBOQUANT=1``
+    in :meth:`NPUPlatform.get_attn_backend_cls`, not the
+    ``turboquant_4bit_nc`` cache dtype that ``validate_turboquant`` above
+    checks: the two are unrelated features that share a name.
+
+    The geometry is checked here rather than at cache-init time so a
+    configuration the carve cannot serve fails while the message can still name
+    the reason.
+
+    Hybrid models (full attention plus Gated DeltaNet, e.g. Qwen3.5) are
+    *supported*: their full-attention layers are described by
+    ``AscendTurboQuantAttentionSpec`` and allocated as their own three planes,
+    while the recurrent layers keep the Mamba allocator and the Mamba page
+    untouched. Nothing is interleaved, so nothing has to be rejected.
+    """
+    from vllm_ascend.attention.turboquant_layout import (
+        E8_HEAD_SIZE,
+        E8_PACKET_ROWS,
+        TURBOQUANT_GROUP,
+        TURBOQUANT_PACK_FACTOR,
+        turboquant_enabled,
+    )
+
+    if not turboquant_enabled():
+        return
+
+    from vllm_ascend.attention.turboquant_config import TURBOQUANT_E8_QUANT_MODE, turboquant_quant_mode
+
+    uses_e8 = turboquant_quant_mode() == TURBOQUANT_E8_QUANT_MODE
+    if uses_e8 and getattr(vllm_config, "use_v2_model_runner", False):
+        raise ValueError("TurboQuant E8 requires the v1 model runner for prepared packet caches")
+
+    model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+    head_size = model_config.get_head_size()
+    if uses_e8 and (head_size != E8_HEAD_SIZE or model_config.dtype != torch.bfloat16):
+        raise ValueError(f"TurboQuant E8 requires D={E8_HEAD_SIZE} and a BF16 model")
+    if uses_e8 and vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size != 1:
+        raise ValueError("TurboQuant E8 requires an unsharded context")
+    if head_size <= 0 or head_size % TURBOQUANT_GROUP:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ENABLE_TURBOQUANT=1 needs head_size to be a positive multiple of {TURBOQUANT_GROUP} "
+            f"(the INT8 K0 of one Hadamard factor), but this model has head_size={head_size}."
+        )
+
+    # block_size is still None here when vLLM derives it later (hybrid models
+    # take it from the Mamba page); the carve re-checks what it gets.
+    block_size = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
+    if uses_e8 and block_size is not None and (block_size <= 0 or block_size % E8_PACKET_ROWS):
+        raise ValueError(f"TurboQuant E8 requires a block size divisible by {E8_PACKET_ROWS}, got {block_size}.")
+    if block_size is not None and block_size % TURBOQUANT_PACK_FACTOR:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ENABLE_TURBOQUANT=1 packs {TURBOQUANT_PACK_FACTOR} INT4 codes per byte, so block_size "
+            f"must be even, got {block_size}."
+        )
+
+    if vllm_config.kv_transfer_config is not None:
+        # The hybrid connectors (ascend_store, mooncake hybrid/layerwise) move
+        # pages shaped `conv | ssm | padding | K | V`. A TurboQuant page is
+        # `K_packed | V_packed | scales`, which those movers would transfer as
+        # if it were dense K/V: wrong numbers on the consumer, not an error.
+        raise ValueError(
+            "ENABLE_TURBOQUANT=1 does not support KV transfer / disaggregated prefill: the "
+            "connectors assume the dense (or hybrid conv/ssm + K/V) page layout, not the packed "
+            "three-plane one."
+        )
+
+    if getattr(model_config, "is_hybrid", False):
+        logger.info(
+            "TurboQuant on a hybrid model: full-attention layers are allocated as their own "
+            "three planes (packed K, packed V, fp32 scales) and are kept out of the Mamba "
+            "pages. Pages stay padded to the hybrid common page size. Private layer buffers "
+            "require a reduced block-pool capacity to stay within the KV memory budget."
+        )
+
+
+def _apply_turboquant_graph_mode(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    """Allow full decode graphs only when the TurboQuant kernel path is available."""
+    from vllm_ascend.attention.turboquant_layout import turboquant_enabled
+
+    if not turboquant_enabled():
+        return
+
+    from vllm.config import CompilationMode
+    from vllm.config.compilation import CUDAGraphMode
+
+    compilation_config = vllm_config.compilation_config
+    if not compilation_config.cudagraph_mode.has_full_cudagraphs():
+        return
+
+    from vllm_ascend.attention.turboquant_v1 import turboquant_decode_graph_supported
+
+    if turboquant_decode_graph_supported():
+        if compilation_config.cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL:
+            # FULL also captures prefill/mixed attention, whose host-side work
+            # is intentionally kept outside the graph in the hybrid mode.
+            compilation_config.cudagraph_mode = (
+                CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
+                if compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE
+                else CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY
+            )
+            logger.warning(
+                "TurboQuant supports full graph capture for single-token decode only; using %s.",
+                compilation_config.cudagraph_mode.name,
+            )
+        return
+
+    # PIECEWISE needs the piecewise compilation that only VLLM_COMPILE does;
+    # without it there is nothing to split, so the honest fallback is no graph.
+    if compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE:
+        downgraded = CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+    else:
+        downgraded = CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+    logger.warning(
+        "TurboQuant full graph capture requires the scatter and decode kernel stages and registered "
+        "scatter, fused decode and decode tiling operators. Falling back from %s to %s.%s",
+        compilation_config.cudagraph_mode.name,
+        downgraded.name,
+        " Attention is split out of the graph there; the rest of the model is still captured."
+        if downgraded == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+        else " Pass a compiled mode to keep graph capture for the rest of the model.",
+    )
+    compilation_config.cudagraph_mode = downgraded
+
+
